experiment: Round430 first-five Max Damage action intervention across two opponents
method: Paired baseline vs intervention on matched teams/previews. Max Damage evaluation alternates Round430 across both player seats. Public Counterplay evaluation keeps Round430 as Player 1. Do not pool effects across opponents or treat this as a trained-policy result.
interpretation: The intervention improves both paired samples, but seat setup differs: Max Damage is side-swapped; Public Counterplay is fixed-seat. The opponent actions are supplied by the heuristic and are not learned policy outputs. Validate with seat-swapped and independent-seed evaluations before using this to justify policy changes.
